observations: Photo 0 shows two stacked electronic keyboards resting on what looks like a keyboard stand.
The top keyboard is black with a small control panel and standard-sized keys; no readable brand or model text.
The bottom keyboard is larger, grey/silver colored, also with a control panel, but no visible brand or model lettering.
A watermark reading 'PRINCE AUDIO' is visible on the image, suggesting a reseller or studio logo, not a manufacturer mark.
No serial number, nameplate, or power adapter is visible in the photo.
It is unclear which of the two keyboards (or both) is the item for sale.

claims.evidence: No Yamaha logo, 'DGX-520' text, or nameplate is legible anywhere in photo 0.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (not explicitly stated but assumed from listing as a keyboard for sale)
claims.evidence: No power-on, display, or sound-test shot provided.

risks.risk: Model/brand cannot be confirmed, which drives most of the price difference between a genuine Yamaha DGX-520 and a generic keyboard.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/logo area above the keys, or the serial number sticker on the back.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/generic portable keyboard, not as a Yamaha DGX-520

risks.risk: Two different keyboards appear in the same photo, unclear which is actually being sold.
risks.proof: A photo isolating the single unit for sale, or confirmation of bundle/split listing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value unit shown, assuming ambiguity favors buyer protection

risks.risk: Functional status unknown (keys, speakers, power supply, screen).
risks.proof: A short video of the keyboard powering on and keys/sound being tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand ownership) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition (scratches, yellowed keys, cracks) not clearly visible due to image angle/lighting.
risks.proof: Close, well-lit photos of the full keyboard body and key surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavy visible wear, worst-case cosmetic grade

proof_requests: Close-up of the nameplate/logo and model number on the actual unit for sale.
A single clear photo of only the item being sold (not both keyboards together).
Video of the keyboard powering on, keys responding, and speakers producing sound.
Photo of included accessories (adapter, pedal, manual, stand if included).
Clear, well-lit photos of the full body showing any scratches, cracks, or discoloration.
response.reason: The photo shows a generic portable keyboard with no legible brand or model markings, so the Yamaha DGX-520 claim is unverifiable and must be priced as an unbranded, untested portable keyboard at worst case until proof of model and function is provided.
